30 days from the date of invoice. Under PP-2023 clause 3.1 standard credit is 30 days from the date of invoice and only Platinum-tier distributors are extended 60 days, so a Gold-tier distributor receives the standard 30 days. Tier is assigned annually by the National Sales Head.

Buyer. Under PP-2023 clause 4.1 all despatches are ex-works and freight, transit insurance and unloading are to the buyer's account irrespective of order value, so the buyer bears freight on a Rs 3,00,000 order shipped in February 2024.

At onboarding a new vendor must submit the GST registration certificate, a cancelled cheque, and an MSME declaration where applicable. Under VOS-7 these are collected by Procurement at step 2 of the onboarding procedure, and all onboarding documents must be filed in The Vault under /Vendors/<vendor code>/ within 7 days of vendor code creation.

June 2026. Under WRP-2020 clause 1.1 products are warranted for 18 months from the date of despatch or 12 months from the date of commissioning, whichever is earlier. Despatch in January 2025 gives July 2026 and commissioning in June 2025 gives June 2026, so the warranty ends in June 2026.
